add.k: A Midtown High football player, Glory's boyfriend
st: In season 1, Kenny Kong helps Flash bully Peter, and Glory dumps him for Harry until he apologizes to her at the formal.
In season 2, he recovers a fumble as Midtown wins State, parties at Flash's birthday and gets into the school play with Glory.

files.notes: Dialogue calls him Kenny, Kong and King Kong (S1E5 onward); the Marvel Database treats Kong as his surname, so n is Kenny Kong. On screen S1E1 to S2E13 (cameo). Midtown High is his school and team. His closest tie, Flash Thompson, is not in network_people, so there is no tie to him.

add.k: A geneticist who joins Curt Connors's lab at ESU
st: In season 2, Dr. Miles Warren joins the ESU lab, mutates Kraven for pay, arms Molten Man and blackmails Curt Connors into leaving.

files.notes: Name said S2E1 ('Dr. Warren', 'Miles') and S2E2 ('Dr. Miles Warren'). The 'Professor Warren' of S1 is his brother Aaron. Transcript: the Kraven treatments are S2E2, the Molten Man armor and the blackmail of Curt are S2E11 (the wiki puts the blackmail in S2E13), and in S2E13 Martha says Dr. Warren is in charge as the Connors leave. Status Active: he is never exposed or caught.

add.k: A doctor who treats Max Dillon and Aunt May
st: In season 1, Dr. Bromwell keeps Max Dillon alive after his accident, then sends May home from the hospital and drives her there.
In season 2, he makes a house call on Valentine's Day and tells May she is fit as a fiddle.

files.notes: Only 'Dr. Bromwell' and 'Doc' are said (S1E2, S1E13, S2E10); Nicholas is never said, so n is Dr. Bromwell. His hospital is never named in dialogue (the Marvel Database gives Manhattan General and Forest Hills Hospital in different places), so tm is Independent. In S1E12 the doctor who reassures Peter about May is unnamed in the transcript ('Thanks, Doc'), so nothing from S1E12 is used; his S1 hospital scene is S1E13.

add.k: A Midtown High football player, Robbie Robertson's son
st: In season 1, Rand plays football for Midtown, dates Sally and helps catch Gwen when Venom hurls her toward the street.
In season 2, he catches a key pass as the Mustangs win State, and teases Flash when Sha Shan skips his party.

files.notes: 'Rand' said S1E1; Peter says 'Rand Robertson' to Robbie in S1E4, so the full name is staged from episode 4. The parade rescue (S1E13) rests on the Marvel Database; the transcript has Sally shouting 'Rand Robertson, don't you dare!' as the team runs to Gwen. The State pass is S2E2 ('Thompson to Robertson').

add.k: A huge strongman in the Enforcers
st: In season 1, Ox fights Spider-Man for the Big Man's Enforcers, then escapes Ryker's Island and goes with Hammerhead.
In season 2, he joins the New Enforcers in a Tinkerer suit, ends up in the Vault and is beaten again when its prisoners are freed.

files.notes: Named Ox in dialogue from S1E1 ('Ox, Fancy Dan, you're up'); Raymond Bloch is never said. S1E11: Hammerhead says 'Ox, Fancy Dan, with me' at the Ryker's breakout. S2E9 New Enforcers (Tinkerer suit), S2E12 Vault. S2E7 is a cameo only. The app's group file sv-enforcers-ssm covers him and stays.

add.k: A perfume tycoon bidding for the Rhino armor specs
st: In season 2, Roderick Kingsley buys the Rhino specs for half a billion, fools Hammerhead and Silver Sable, then loses the drive.

files.notes: S2E8 only; 'Mr. Kingsley' and 'Sold, to Roderick Kingsley' are said. Someone asks whether he owns a perfume company, but no company is named, so tm is Independent. Menken refuses him a refund, and Norman reveals the drive Kingsley got was a fake. op Spider-Man is nominal: Spider-Man fights Hammerhead, Sable and Rhino over the case, not Kingsley himself.

add.k: A Midtown High sophomore Flash keeps asking out
st: In season 2, Sha Shan Nguyen keeps turning Flash down, then dances with him on Valentine's Day once he proves he is honest.

files.notes: Full name first said S2E5 ('Sha Shan Nguyen. Sophomore.'); on screen S2E5, S2E6, S2E7, S2E9 and S2E10 in the transcripts (the Marvel Database also has her in the background in S2E1 and S2E2). Her main tie is Flash Thompson, who is not in network_people. The S2E6 audition Devereaux praises is unnamed in the transcript, so there is no tie to him and she has no ties.

add.k: A Broadway star directing Midtown High's school play
st: In season 2, Broadway star St. John Devereaux directs Midtown's A Midsummer Night's Dream and sends Hobie on as Puck when Harry is missing.

files.notes: Name said in S1E11 (Peter mentions he is playing Falstaff) and S2E5 ('Sinjin Devereaux', introduced as the play's guest director). The Marvel Database lists him in S1E11, but the transcript only names him there, so S1 gets no step. Group Midtown High, since he is the school's guest instructor. He casts Flash as Nick Bottom in S2E7.

add.k: An NYPD sergeant, Officer DeWolff's partner
st: In season 1, Stan Carter hears his partner say Spider-Man's arrests never stick, and answers the call when the Sinister Six attack.
In season 2, Sergeant Carter backs Spider-Man and tells students on a ride-along that Spider-Man hasn't gone far enough.

files.notes: 'Stan' said by DeWolff in S1E1 ('He's not helping, Stan'); 'Carter, Dewolff, with me' in S1E11; 'Sergeant Carter' and 'Sarge' in S2E9. The S1E2 Max Dillon exchange and the Sandman barricade (really S1E5, an unnamed 'COP') rest only on the Marvel Database and are left out. Jean DeWolff, his partner, is not in network_people, so there is no tie to her; 'Jean' is never said.

add.k: A wrestling promoter who hires Spider-Man
st: In season 1, wrestling promoter Sullivan Edwards won't pay Spider-Man without a contract, and Spider-Man lets the thief who robs him escape.

files.notes: He names himself in S1E12 ('an exclusive management contract with Sullivan Edwards, i.e., me'). He works the wrestling venue, but no company is named, so tm is Independent. The Marvel Database also lists him in S2E12, but only in a memory of the same scene, so no S2 step.

add.k: A Tri-Corp scientist holding Otto's power source
st: In season 1, Dr. Twaki tells Doctor Octopus where the Megalo-pack is, explains it to Spider-Man and goes into hiding.

files.notes: S1E8 only; Otto says 'Dr. Twaki'. Theodore or Ted is never said, so n is Dr. Twaki. Tri-Corp is named on screen in S1E4, and S1E8 is Otto's old workplace where Twaki holds the Megalo-pack, which matches the app's Tri-Corp. The Marvel Database calls him the head of Tricorp, which the transcript doesn't state, so k doesn't say it.

add.k: Curt and Martha Connors's young son
st: In season 1, Billy sees his father become the Lizard and follows him to the zoo, giving Spider-Man the opening to cure him.
In season 2, Billy leaves New York with his parents when they move to Florida.

files.notes: 'Billy' said in S1E2 and S1E3, and Curt says 'He is a Connors.' On screen S1E1 to S1E3 and S2E13 (Marvel Database). He is a child with no group, so tm is Independent. The S2 step rests on Martha telling Gwen the family is leaving for Florida (S2E13) and the Marvel Database listing him there.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny tries to trip Harry at football tryouts and then pranks him, so Glory dumps Kenny and leaves with Harry. At the formal Kenny apologizes and Glory takes him back.
stages.whoA: The teammate Glory leaves him for
stages.whoB: The teammate who keeps picking on him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny helps Flash torment Peter, eating his lunch and pelting him with water balloons. At football tryouts Peter and Harry give Kenny a rough time.
stages.whoA: The geek he and Flash pick on
stages.whoB: Flash's teammate and fellow bully

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kenny and Rand play on the Midtown football team and run with the same popular crowd. In the State final Kenny recovers a fumble and Rand catches a key pass as the Mustangs win.
stages.whoA: His teammate on the Mustangs
stages.whoB: His teammate on the Mustangs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt welcomes Miles to the ESU lab, but Miles wants to build on Curt's lizard research. When Curt finds his plans for human armor tests and threatens to go to the board, Miles threatens to expose Curt's past as the Lizard, and the Connors leave New York.
stages.whoA: The ESU colleague he blackmails out
stages.whoB: The colleague who blackmails him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven tracks Spider-Man's scent to Miles's lab and pays him to make him a better hunter. After days of treatments with an electrolyzed lizard mutagen, Kraven is transformed.
stages.whoA: The hunter he mutates for money
stages.whoB: The scientist who mutates him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Miles puts Mark Allan in a new armor and coaches him to switch it on and off with his mind. Mark becomes Molten Man.
stages.whoA: The young man he puts in molten armor
stages.whoB: The scientist who builds his armor

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt introduces Miles to his intern Gwen, and Miles says his brother speaks highly of her. When the Connors leave ESU, Miles takes charge of the lab where Gwen works.
stages.whoA: An intern in his lab
stages.whoB: The new head of her lab

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Curt introduces Miles to his intern Peter, whose biology professor is Miles's brother. When the Connors leave ESU, Miles takes charge of the lab where Peter works.
stages.whoA: An intern in his lab
stages.whoB: The new head of his lab

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Bromwell treats May after her heart attack, sends her home for Thanksgiving and drives her there himself. On Valentine's Day he makes a house call and tells her she is fit as a fiddle.
stages.whoA: His patient, who has a heart attack
stages.whoB: Her doctor, who drives her home

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When Peter asks if everything is okay, Dr. Bromwell tells him and May that she can go home from the hospital for Thanksgiving.
stages.whoA: His patient's nephew
stages.whoB: Aunt May's doctor

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter asks Robbie whether he knows a Rand Robertson. Robbie jokes that a kid by that name lives in his house and eats all his food.
stages.whoA: His father, the Bugle's editor
stages.whoB: His son, a Midtown football player

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Sally is Rand's girlfriend, and Rand just shrugs when Peter asks her out. When Rand runs to help catch Gwen at the parade, Sally begs him not to.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, a cheerleader
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend on the football team

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Rand takes it in stride when Peter asks out Sally, and he shields Peter from Flash's water balloons. He is the one football player who never bullies him.
stages.whoA: The classmate he stands up for
stages.whoB: The friendliest of the football players

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Montana leads Ox and Fancy Dan against Spider-Man for the Big Man. Later Montana, now the Shocker, leads the New Enforcers with Ox in a Tinkerer suit, and both end up in the Vault.
stages.whoA: His leader in the Enforcers
stages.whoB: His big Enforcer muscle

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Big Man hires the Enforcers, and Ox fights Spider-Man on his orders. Later the Big Man looks over Ox and the New Enforcers in their Tinkerer gear and likes what he sees.
stages.whoA: The crime lord he works for
stages.whoB: One of his Enforcers

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When the villains break out of Ryker's Island, Hammerhead takes Ox and Fancy Dan with him while Montana stays with the others.
stages.whoA: The mobster he follows off Ryker's
stages.whoB: An Enforcer who leaves Ryker's with him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer builds Ox a strength suit for the New Enforcers. Montana becomes the Shocker and Fancy Dan becomes Ricochet, but Ox keeps his old name.
stages.whoA: The inventor who builds his suit
stages.whoB: The Enforcer he builds a suit for

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ox fights Spider-Man for the Big Man and can snap his webbing. Spider-Man beats him again when he returns in a Tinkerer suit, and again when the Vault's prisoners are freed.
stages.whoA: The hero who keeps beating him
stages.whoB: A huge Enforcer who can snap webs

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kingsley outbids Hammerhead for the Rhino specs. When Hammerhead tries to steal the prize, he finds that Kingsley handed him an empty box.
stages.whoA: A bidder he outbids and fools
stages.whoB: The buyer who fools him with an empty box

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kingsley outbids Silver Sable's side for the Rhino specs. When Sable tries to steal the prize, she finds that Kingsley handed her an empty box.
stages.whoA: A rival he fools with a decoy
stages.whoB: The buyer who fools her with an empty box

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Rhino catches up with Kingsley, angry that anyone else might wear his suit, and Kingsley runs. The case of specs is destroyed in the brawl that follows.
stages.whoA: The villain who hunts him for the specs
stages.whoB: The man who buys the specs to his suit

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Devereaux casts Harry as Puck, the lead in his school play. On opening night Harry never shows, so Devereaux sends Hobie on in his place.
stages.whoA: The student he casts as Puck
stages.whoB: The director who gives him the lead

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Devereaux posts his cast list, and Kenny and Glory both get into the play.
stages.whoA: A football player in his cast
stages.whoB: The director of the school play

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Carter serves under Captain Stacy and joins the police as they take on the Sinister Six. Later Stacy runs a student ride-along and assigns students to Carter's car.
stages.whoA: His captain
stages.whoB: A sergeant under his command

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Unlike his partner, Carter backs Spider-Man. On the ride-along he says Spider-Man hasn't gone far enough.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero he backs
stages.whoB: A police sergeant on his side

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter wins a wrestling match as Spider-Man, but Edwards refuses to pay without a management contract. When a thief robs him, Peter lets the man go.
stages.whoA: The masked wrestler he won't pay
stages.whoB: The promoter who cheats him

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto returns to his old workplace and threatens Dr. Twaki, who kept the Megalo-pack Otto built. Twaki tells him it is in vault 8.
stages.whoA: His old employee, now a villain
stages.whoB: The doctor who kept his invention

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man grabs the Megalo-pack from Doctor Octopus, and Dr. Twaki explains that it holds a charge for years. Spider-Man tells him to hide.
stages.whoA: The hero who tells him to hide
stages.whoB: The doctor who explains the Megalo-pack

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Billy reads about lizards like his father and sees Curt turn into the Lizard. At the zoo Billy begs his dad to stop, giving Spider-Man the moment he needs to cure him. Later the family moves to Florida.
stages.whoA: His father, who becomes the Lizard
stages.whoB: His young son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Martha tries to keep Billy from seeing his father change, but he sees it anyway. Later the family leaves New York for Florida.
stages.whoA: His mother
stages.whoB: Her young son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Billy asks Peter whether his father will still care about him if he turns into a monster. Peter promises that his dad always will.
stages.whoA: The intern who comforts him
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors's son

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen stays with Billy while Martha goes after the Lizard, but Billy follows his father to the zoo.
stages.whoA: The intern who looks after him
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors's son

changes.now: In season 1, Stan Carter hears his partner say Spider-Man's arrests never stick, and answers the call when the Sinister Six attack.
changes.why: The S1E2 line telling Max Dillon 'it's either a hospital room or a jail cell' has no speaker in the transcript and nothing on screen ties it to Carter; only the Marvel Database does. What the transcript does tie to him: DeWolff says 'He's not helping, Stan. The perps he nabs almost always walk' in S1E1, and 'Carter, Dewolff, with me' in S1E11.
